items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out mid-game with concussion after evaluation for head injury.
items.implication: Protocol next week; Chargers WR depth tested
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston or others elevated targets/routes

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive after GTD/questionable ankle; Browns depth limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee).
items.why: Ankle; practiced once; pregame workout failed
items.implication: Zero upside this week; thin Browns backfield

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive (groin); Tyjae Spears active opposite.
items.opportunity: Increased TE targets elsewhere or RB/WR

items.text: Weekend summary GTD: Judkins, Tyler Warren, Mike Evans/Christian Kirk. Expected: Caleb Williams, Olave/Kamara, AJ Brown/Henderson, DK Metcalf, Freiermuth, Sadiq. Not expected: Deebo, Croskey-Merritt, Tucker. Activated: Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Core status tracking for lineup locks

items.text: Post-game watch: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion already out), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), Doubs/Bateman/Mooney shoulders/neck.
items.implication: Next-week status TBD; Kincaid returned so less concern

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson (both ankle Q) officially active; NE near full health with Brown return.
items.implication: Brown immediate WR upside; Henderson RB role

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start but riskier flex post-rotation news; prefer his explosiveness for score chance vs NO); Najee RB33.
items.why: Rotation change after fumbles; preseason hate list reason
items.implication: Flex over RB2; monitor actual snaps

items.text: Cam Skattebo 37th/43 in rush YOE with 4 fumbles (1 lost); Giants expected to expand Najee Harris role while keeping Skattebo in mix; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles; coach comments post-game zero carries not by design but rotation change
items.opportunity: Najee larger share; Tracy/Singletary still involved
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for TD chance vs NO as flex over pure RB2

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara expected to play (illness tags leaning probable).
Caleb Williams expected to play/return; later confirmed back with victory speeches.
Colston Loveland finally scored; ends TE nightmare. Meanwhile useless TE TDs continue (e.g. Alie-Cox).
Loves run-heavy scripts: Walker fresh off bye at home (Reid), Jaylen Warren hottest RB; Huntley back favors BAL run vs CLE.
items.implication: Start with confidence in run-heavy spots

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
